description: Hybrid ensemble: v11 forward-DNA HistGradientBoosting (weight 0.50, full 672K coverage) + 8 API instruction judges (deepseek, kimi, openai_mini, openai_4o, xai, cohere, haiku-v2, opus) on adversarial test-outlier subset (~1.5% of rows), weighted by cross-validated train AUC with floor=0.005 (no judge silenced). Global Platt scaling fit on 24K-row labeled impersonation_pool reduces log-loss 6× vs raw v11. Internal labeled-holdout AUC=0.991, log-loss=0.111, top-quartile-confidence accuracy 99.92%.
